reuse.why: All link rules go through the existing linkBankSyncAccount, Fintegra linking is a thin wrapper like the other providers, and the unlink field-clearing is extracted into clearAccountLink and reused by unlinkAccount; the Fintegra download and accounts functions copy Akahu's instead of sharing a helper.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions and fintegraAccounts are near-verbatim copies of the Akahu functions, differing only in the server URL and log text, though that per-provider copying is the tree's existing pattern.

placement.why: Duplicate-link, closed-account and replace rules live in the shared linkBankSyncAccount, provider download in sync.ts, server URL in server-config and types in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes are confined to what the four steps need; the extra fintegra-accounts listing handler is a small, related addition.

maintainability.why: Linking rules are in one place and the unlink state is shared; the only debt is another copied per-provider download/accounts function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra links via linkBankSyncAccount and replaced links are cleared via the new shared clearAccountLink also used by unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The Akahu-to-Fintegra copies are open copies (same structure, renamed URL/log), not reshaped; the unlink update was shared rather than copied.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink; the duplicate and closed-account checks are general rules applied to all providers, and no caller bypasses it. Fintegra is added to existing provider dispatches in syncAccount/processBankSyncDownload.
